purpose: Seed for EP02 SC05 after EP02 SC04 formal test-mode segment. Use this to plan the next 8-10 second short-drama shots through ComfyUI.
title: 空庭无人，箫声引路

continuity_from.approval_mode: Codex auto-pass test mode with user authorization
continuity_from.caveat: SC04 is approved only for pipeline validation. Storyboard costume color drift was noted in SH02/SH03/SH04; production should tighten Tuobaye reference locking.

source_grounding.anchor_after: 湖水清澈，松竹四合，对面竹林憧影中依稀可以看见有亭阁楼台。
source_grounding.adapted_summary: 拓拔野与白龙鹿从天湖岸边绕湖前往疑似青帝居所。亭阁以松木与竹子搭成，素朴无华；一人一兽穿过长廊、竹楼、高台和后院，却四处空无人影。风吹竹影、月照西墙之际，东南方忽然传来若有若无的箫声，拓拔野误以为可能是青帝或神农线索，于是循声穿过竹林与矮竹墙。
source_grounding.next_source_hint: 箫声将拓拔野引向湖边小亭、焚香、石壁文字，并最终引出白衣女子。

continuity_rules: Adult-adapted Tuobaye only: age 28 to 32, rugged grey-brown rough cloth layers, rope belt, travel pouch, relic bundle, green bamboo flute at waist, Wufeng in a bamboo sheath at the right waist.
White dragon-deer remains a friendly mythic mount with white deer body, pearl neck and shoulder scales, pale jade antlers, long white mane, calm intelligent eyes.
Wufeng remains a plain dark blunt rectangular edgeless black iron object inside or tied to a bamboo sheath; it must not look like a sharp heroic sword.
The青帝居所 should be austere and handcrafted: pine logs, bamboo corridors, plain platforms, no gold palace, no ornate imperial architecture, no modern garden.
No visible Qingdi or white-clothed woman in this segment. The reveal should be deferred to the next segment.
The emotional arc shifts from awe to uncertainty, then to fascination as the distant flute sound appears.
localization_rules: All planning text and eventual editing dialogue should be Chinese unless a technical field requires English.
Storyboard prompts may describe Chinese short-drama style, but must request no readable screen text.
I2V prompts must use silent visual generation: no synthesized speech, no captions, no subtitles, no readable signs, no English words.
Chinese dialogue, narration, flute sound design, and subtitles should be added later in editing.

generation_policy.orchestration: ComfyUI only; cloud APIs must be called through Comfy workflow nodes.
generation_policy.gemini_video_mode: experimental_file_ids only while current local backend supports it; otherwise use official T2V smoke tests or switch provider for formal I2V
generation_policy.review_gate: Test-mode auto-pass may be used while operator is absent, but record it clearly and preserve known quality issues.
generation_policy.secret_hygiene: Use api_key_env_path or local key indirection; do not inject plaintext keys into Comfy prompt JSON/history.
generation_policy.motion_safety: Prefer stable camera, slow walking, light bamboo/water movement, and reaction shots; avoid complex running until a simplified fallback is planned.

suggested_shots.title: 绕湖靠近松竹亭阁
suggested_shots.visual_focus: Tuobaye and the white dragon-deer move quietly along the moonlit Tianhu shore toward simple pine-and-bamboo pavilions across the water.

suggested_shots.title: 穿廊登台四处无人
suggested_shots.visual_focus: They pass through plain bamboo corridors and a pine-wood platform, searching for Qingdi, but the residence is empty.

suggested_shots.title: 空庭月影忽闻箫声
suggested_shots.visual_focus: In the empty courtyard, Tuobaye pauses among wind-blown bamboo shadows as a faint flute sound seems to arrive from the southeast.

suggested_shots.title: 循声穿过矮竹墙
suggested_shots.visual_focus: Tuobaye and the dragon-deer move carefully through bamboo and along a low bamboo wall, drawn toward the unseen source of the flute.
